subject: SeedFlow: embeddings + rerank onboarding + vector DB decision log
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@brightlearn.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@brightlearn.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SeedFlow kickoff: embeddings + rerank onboarding and DB decisions

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Congrats again on picking Redwood for search relevance — excited to get BrightLearn onto embeddings + rerank. To avoid surprises during the implementation handoff, I sketched a short decision log and a proposed onboarding timeline (attached). High-level asks:

- Vector DB: do you want us to host vectors in Redwood's managed store (recommended for SLA + low ops) or migrate into your existing DB (we currently support Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, and customers with self-hosted FAISS flows)? If self-hosted, we need connection details and an SLA window.
- Index seeding/backfill: estimate of document count (you mentioned ~1.2M content nodes) and a workable maintenance window for backfill. We can do incremental seeding to reduce spike costs.
- Rerank evals: we need a 200–500 example eval set (queries + ground-truth clicks) to calibrate candidates vs full rerank. Our recommended metrics: MRR@10, NDCG@5, and percent-regression on served queries.

Proposed timeline (week-level):
1) This week: alignment call (30m) + export sample (5k docs)
2) Week 2: seed alpha index to staging + run rerank baseline evals
3) Week 3: iterate thresholds, production backfill plan, smoke tests

Attachments: seed-plan-v1.xlsx (timeline + cost estimates), rerank-eval-spec.md (format + sample schema).

Questions for BrightLearn: any network constraints (VPC peering, IP allowlists), preferred vector DB vendor, and whether you need data residency in us-east vs us-west.

If that all looks okay I’ll 1) lock the workshop time, 2) create a Drive folder and 3) assign an initial task list to Monica for the CS handoff.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solution Engineering | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Park <sarah@brightlearn.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom@brightlearn.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SeedFlow kickoff: embeddings + rerank onboarding and DB decisions

Thanks Vivek — glad to get started. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Vector DB: We're currently running an in-house Elasticsearch + vector plugin for prototypes but would prefer a managed vector DB for production (Pinecone or Weaviate). Key requirement: data must remain in us-east-1.
- Document count: 1.18M (articles + snippets + user notes). Average doc size is ~1.2 KB, derived from our analytics export.
- Backfill window: we have a nightly maintenance window 01:00–05:00 ET and can allow a weekend full-backfill if needed (prefer to avoid daytime traffic spikes).
- Rerank evals: we'll extract a 500-query sample with click labels from the last 90 days. Can you confirm schema you need?

Also, we already have a request in our security intake for SOC2 evidence; Monica, Naomi — can you loop in SRE/security for the connection playbook (VPC peering + KMS)?

Happy to join an alignment call tomorrow morning if that works on your side.

Best,
Sarah

--
Sarah Park
Head of Product, BrightLearn
sarah@brightlearn.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

On Mon, Jul 19, 2026 at 12:08 PM, Sarah Park <sarah@brightlearn.com> wrote:
> Thanks Vivek — glad to get started. A few quick notes from our side:
>
> - Vector DB: ... prefer a managed vector DB for production (Pinecone or Weaviate). Key requirement: data must remain in us-east-1.
> - Document count: 1.18M ...

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Sarah. Immediate next steps from Redwood CS: 

1) Workshop: I scheduled a 45m workshop for 2026-07-21 10:00 ET (invites sent). Agenda: data export format, network gating (VPC/peering options), and a short live run of our seeding tool on a 5k sample.
2) Security intake: Naomi, can you share the SOC2 checklist packet and the connection playbook draft with BrightLearn SRE?
3) Seed plan changes: Vivek, I updated the attached seed-plan-v1.xlsx with a weekend backfill option and estimated peak QPS. Please review and confirm the weekend schedule.
4) Rerank evals: Sarah — thanks, please drop the 500-query set in the Drive folder in CSV with columns: query, doc_id, click_flag (0/1), timestamp. We'll add canonicalization scripts if needed.

I'll own coordination and status updates. Monica (CS) will be the main point during implementation; Vivek will handle performance tuning and kernel selection during staging.

Thanks all — see you on the workshop.

Monica

--
Monica Patel

Date: 2026-07-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SeedFlow kickoff: embeddings + rerank onboarding and DB decisions

Thanks everyone — quick summary & decision log (action items below).

Decisions made:
- Vector DB: BrightLearn prefers a managed vendor. Action: Redwood to provision a staging Pinecone instance in us-east-1 for the alpha seed. Production choice to be finalized after cost/runbook review (Monica to lead).
- Backfill window: Weekend full-backfill approved (start 2026-07-31 01:00 ET). We'll do an incremental alpha seed to staging this week.
- Eval set: BrightLearn will upload a 500-query CSV to the shared Drive by EOD 7/22. Redwood will run MRR@10 and NDCG@5 baselines and report regressions.

Action items: 
1) Monica: confirm Drive folder permissions and share SOC2 packet with BrightLearn SRE (due 7/22).
2) Naomi: add instructions for KMS key exchange + allowlist to the connection playbook (due 7/23).
3) Vivek: provision Pinecone staging, run sample seed on 5k export, capture peak QPS (complete by 7/24).
4) BrightLearn (Sarah/Tom): upload 5k sample export and the 500-query eval set to Drive (due 7/22).

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-seedflow-briefing (work artifacts), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1379 (ticket).

If there are any blockers, flag them on the Jira ticket and I'll triage. Otherwise I'll post a short readout after the staging seed.

Best,
Vivek
